en_title: Daredevil Star Charlie Cox Asked for a James Bond Audition but Was Told He Was 'Too Old'
cn_title: 《夜魔侠》明星查理·考克斯请求试镜詹姆斯·邦德，却被告知自己「年纪太大」
opus_summary: 《夜魔侠》主演查理·考克斯称，他曾向经纪人询问试镜詹姆斯·邦德，却因年龄被拒，连试镜机会都没有。43岁的考克斯还称赞获得该角色的罗伯特·帕丁森事业出色。

paragraphs.en: Daredevil star Charlie Cox says he was denied a James Bond audition after being told he was already "too old" to play 007, prior to the casting of Twilight and Batman star Robert Pattinson .
paragraphs.cn: 《夜魔侠》明星查理·考克斯表示，在《暮光之城》和《蝙蝠侠》明星罗伯特·帕丁森获选之前，他被告知自己已经「年纪太大」，无法出演007，因此没能获得詹姆斯·邦德的试镜机会。

paragraphs.en: Despite spending the past decade throwing himself into brutal hallway brawls, Cox said he couldn't even audition to be the new James Bond because of his age. Speaking today on Virgin Radio , the 43-year-old Marvel star said he'd asked his agent about becoming the new 00 agent, only to be quickly shut down.
paragraphs.cn: 尽管过去十年里一直投身于残酷的走廊肉搏戏，考克斯表示，自己却因为年龄问题，连试镜新一任詹姆斯·邦德的机会都没有。这位43岁的漫威明星今天在Virgin Radio上表示，他曾向经纪人询问出演新一任00特工的事，却很快遭到了回绝。

paragraphs.en: "I asked to audition for that, do you know what they told me? Too old," Cox laughed, admitting that he didn't even make it into an audition room. "Rob's the same age as me!" he continued, before being told that, actually, the Batman actor is three years younger.
paragraphs.cn: 「我请求试镜那个角色，你知道他们怎么跟我说吗？年纪太大了。」考克斯笑着说，并承认自己甚至没能走进试镜室。「罗伯和我一样大！」他接着说道，随后有人告诉他，这位《蝙蝠侠》演员实际上比他小三岁。

paragraphs.en: "What an amazing career that guy's carved out," Cox said, praising Pattinson for getting the part. "Some of the stuff he's done, the directors he's worked with... just amazing."
paragraphs.cn: 「这家伙开创了多么了不起的事业。」考克斯称赞帕丁森拿到了这个角色时说道。「他做过的一些事，合作过的导演……简直太了不起了。」

paragraphs.en: While Cox wouldn't have been the oldest actor cast as James Bond, he would have certainly been on the older end. Sean Connery was 32 years old when he gained 007 status, George Lazenby was 30 years old, Roger Moore was 45 years old, Timothy Dalton was 41 years old, Pierce Brosnan was 42 years old, and Daniel Craig was 38 years old.
paragraphs.cn: 虽然考克斯不会是获选出演詹姆斯·邦德时年龄最大的演员，但他的年龄肯定属于较大的一档。肖恩·康纳利成为007时32岁，乔治·拉扎贝30岁，罗杰·摩尔45岁，提摩西·道尔顿41岁，皮尔斯·布鲁斯南42岁，丹尼尔·克雷格38岁。

paragraphs.en: Still, for fans who have watched Cox effortlessly pull off both sharp-suited charm as Matt Murdock and relentless physical stunts as his superhero alter ego, ruling the actor out immediately is a shame — particularly now his crime-fighting days may be nearing an end with Disney's culling of Daredevil: Born Again following its forthcoming third season.
paragraphs.cn: 尽管如此，对于看着考克斯既能游刃有余地演绎马特·默多克身着挺括西装的魅力，又能以其超级英雄另一重身份完成不停歇的高难度动作戏的粉丝来说，直接将这位演员排除在外令人遗憾——尤其是如今，随着迪士尼决定在即将推出的第三季之后砍掉《夜魔侠：重生》，他打击犯罪的日子可能即将结束。

paragraphs.en: Pattinson's casting as Bond ended years of speculation over who would take on the role, and months of unusually detailed reporting on the actors who came close behind Pattinson in the running. Callum Turner (One Night Only) and Jacob Elordi (Euphoria) were two faces talked about earlier on, with Slow Horses star Jack Lowden then entering the conversation shortly after. Finally, just last month, Amazon reportedly narrowed its search to a small collection of actors , including Lowden, Turner, and Josh O'Connor (Challengers). Earlier in the process, everyone from Nicholas Hoult (Mad Max: Fury Road) to Dunkirk actor Harry Styles also tested. So, regardless of being allowed to audition or not, Cox faced some tough competition.
paragraphs.cn: 帕丁森获选出演邦德，终结了多年来关于谁会接演这一角色的猜测，也结束了数月来对竞争中紧随帕丁森之后的演员们异常详尽的报道。卡勒姆·特纳（《One Night Only》）和雅各布·艾洛蒂（《亢奋》）是早期被谈及的两位人选，不久后，《流人》明星杰克·劳登也进入了讨论范围。最终，据报道，就在上个月，亚马逊将搜寻范围缩小到少数几位演员，包括劳登、特纳和乔什·奥康纳（《挑战者》）。在选角过程的早些时候，从尼古拉斯·霍尔特（《疯狂的麦克斯：狂暴之路》）到《敦刻尔克》演员哈里·斯泰尔斯等人也都参加了试镜。因此，无论是否获准试镜，考克斯面对的竞争都十分激烈。
